granularity_level: EU macro-region only (Northern/Central/Southern Europe); no within-country resolution
key_limitation: No downloadable data; resolves only to 3 European macro-regions, no within-Austria differentiation.

short_description: EU-wide multi-hazard risk and loss data platform
key_limitation: Vulnerability and Risk Analysis modules are documented by JRC as ongoing work.

short_description: Wildfire danger index and burnt-area data for Europe
key_limitation: Wildfire only; raw time-varying raster requires own aggregation choice and GIS overlay.

short_description: Climate variables and derived hazard reference datasets
operator: ECMWF on behalf of the EU
key_limitation: General-purpose raw data, not a ready-made hazard layer; sub-datasets may carry stricter licence terms.

short_description: Aggregated ESG risk indicators at EU bank level
key_limitation: Aggregate bank-level statistics only; no per-exposure data at all.

short_description: Methodology and euro-area statistics on physical risk exposure
key_limitation: Underlying data (AnaCredit/RIAD) not accessible to an SNCI; only the methodology is usable.

short_description: National flood extent dataset (HQ30/HQ100/HQ300) combining Abflussuntersuchungen (ABU), HORA and, in part, BWV/WLV hazard zoning plans
operator: Umweltbundesamt GmbH, on behalf of BMLUK (data owner)
granularity_level: Vector, 1:25,000 (national harmonisation of parcel/address-level state source data)
web_interface_type: OGC WMS/WFS + INSPIRE Atom download service
download_format: GML / Shapefile (per hazard layer, direct .zip links)
key_limitation: Data currency ~6 years old (Oct 2020); composite of sources with differing vintages.

short_description: National hazard zoning for torrents, avalanches and mass movements
operator: Forsttechnischer Dienst fuer Wildbach- und Lawinenverbauung (BMLUK)
key_limitation: Mapped only within settled areas; unmapped location does not necessarily mean no hazard.

short_description: Address-level natural hazard viewer for Austria
operator: BML / Austrian Insurance Association / GeoSphere Austria
key_limitation: No bulk/API access - individual queries only; map content not legally binding.

short_description: Global water stress and drought risk indicators
download_format: CSV, Shapefile, GeoPackage (.gpkg) - baseline data CSV/GeoPackage only, exceeds shapefile column limit
key_limitation: Global tool not locally validated for Austria; watershed-level granularity, coarser than parcel level.

short_description: Commercial facility-level physical climate risk scores
key_limitation: Storm = tropical cyclones only (not Austria-relevant); heat wave and drought coverage unconfirmed.

short_description: Commercial natural hazard and climate scenario scores
key_limitation: Heat/drought/water stress only in a separate, unnamed "13 climate hazards" edition - unconfirmed.

source_name: World Bank Data Catalog / Risk Data Library (RDL)
short_description: Global historical disaster and climate risk datasets
granularity_level: District (ADM2) level via ThinkHazard!; Risk Data Library dataset granularity varies (e.g. global landslide hazard map is gridded)
download_format: JSON, XML, CSV (API); format varies by dataset for Risk Data Library
key_limitation: ThinkHazard! differentiates only to district (ADM2) level, coarser than the parcel-level Austrian sources; the bundled Risk Data Library has separate, dataset-specific granularity.

short_description: Austrian permafrost, glacier and snow monitoring reports
key_limitation: Station-based narrative reports, not a spatial layer; cannot be overlaid with portfolio locations.

short_description: Official OeNACE 2025 assignment per company, keyed to the Firmenbuch number
key_limitation: Companies without an assigned OeNACE code remain unmatched.

short_description: Commercial Austrian company data service with OeNACE codes
key_limitation: Cost is institution-dependent; some banks may already hold a sector licence.
